name: dbgateway-editor
description: SQL editor of the dbgateway web UI (CodeMirror 6), bundled into internal/web/ui/static/editor.js

scripts.build: esbuild src/editor.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2020 --legal-comments=none --banner:js="/* dbgateway SQL editor. Bundles CodeMirror 6 (MIT, https://codemirror.net) and @lezer (MIT). See web/editor/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES. */" --outfile=../../internal/web/ui/static/editor.js
